notes: S2-FIX6 (decision 2026-11-16 #13; §9.1 rule 4, §5.3 governing window; F87 of the Rust follow-up): two self-attested human declarations of one key that no keyset root reaches, D1 at T0 with valid_until T1 and D2 at T2 without a window. Both are untrusted (E_KEY_UNTRUSTED, N_SELF_ATTESTED_ROOT_KEY). An untrusted declaration is not semantically valid and "MUST NOT make any other declaration invalid", so D1 governs no window: D2's self-signature is not E_KEY_EXPIRED.
